link.title: The Browser Asset Catalog
link.description: The browser asset catalog keeps files in this browser for every script you open here, whatever its project: the quick way to try a STEP model, a glTF file or a font in any project. Its files belong to no project, so they are not exported with one and cannot be moved to the cloud; for anything you keep, add the file to its project instead. These pages cover uploading files to the catalog and loading glTF and STEP files from it in Rete, Blockly and TypeScript.
